doc.description:
Module to be able to use an QMC5883L magnetometer.
Intorduction: Honeywell discontinued the HMC5983/HMC5883L in 2016 and licensed the technology to QST Corporation, who now manufacture the replacement QMC5883L. However, while the QMC5883L is pin compatible with HMC, it's registers are not the same as the Honeywell device. It's essentially a different chip.
QST Corporation have produced two versions of the QMC5883L: A completely undocumented 'A' version with "DA 5883" on the QFN package that responds to the I2C address 0x1E. It's identical to the HMC5983/HMC5883L, except that the status register doesn't work. The DA 5883 is not supported by this driver since we have not seen any samples of this DA version in the wild
A documented 'B' version with "DB 5833" on the QFN package that responds to I2C address 0x0D. This works as per the QMC5883L datasheet.
FILTERING: A 3 Hz second-order Butterworth low-pass filter is enabled by default. Live tests at 200 Hz reduced RMS noise by about 82%, peak-to-peak noise by 77-80%, and maximum sample steps by 80-87%. It is enabled because the QMC5883L can exhibit sustained axis noise that is not removed by maximum sensor oversampling or short median filters.
The filter penalty is approximately 75 ms group delay at low frequencies, 96 bytes of filter state, and 15 floating-point multiplications per sample (about 3000/s at 200 Hz), which is negligible CPU load on typical flight controllers. A 3 Hz cutoff was the measured compromise: higher cutoffs restored significant peaks, while lower cutoffs added delay for little practical benefit. Set QMC5883L_USE_LOWPASS_FILTER to FALSE only when unfiltered response is explicitly required.
TIP: An arbitrary rotation between the sensor frame and the IMU frame can be compensated with a MAG_TO_IMU rotation, defined by three euler angles. The three angles must be defined to enable this correction. Otherwise it is assumed that the IMU and MAG axis are aligned.

define.name: MODULE_QMC5883L_SYNC_SEND
define.description: Send IMU_RAW message with each new measurement for debugging purposes (default: FALSE)

define.name: MODULE_QMC5883L_FILTER_SYNC_SEND
define.description: Send paired unfiltered ID 32 and filtered ID 7 IMU_MAG_RAW telemetry at 20 Hz (default: FALSE)

define.name: MODULE_QMC5883L_UPDATE_AHRS
define.description: Copy measurements to IMU and send as ABI message (default: FALSE)

define.name: QMC5883L_CHAN_X_SIGN
define.description: Set the polarity of x axis (default: +)

define.name: QMC5883L_CHAN_Y_SIGN
define.description: Set the polarity of y axis (default: +)

define.name: QMC5883L_CHAN_Z_SIGN
define.description: Set the polarity of z axis (default: +)

define.name: QMC5883L_USE_LOWPASS_FILTER
define.description: Apply a second-order Butterworth low-pass filter to sensor samples (default: TRUE)

define.name: QMC5883L_LOWPASS_CUTOFF
define.description: Butterworth low-pass cutoff frequency in Hz

define.name: MAG_TO_IMU_PHI
define.description: Rotation between sensor frame and IMU frame (phi angle)

define.name: MAG_TO_IMU_THETA
define.description: Rotation between sensor frame and IMU frame (theta angle)

define.name: MAG_TO_IMU_PSI
define.description: Rotation between sensor frame and IMU frame (psi angle)

makefile.raw: ifeq ($(MAG_QMC5883L_I2C_DEV),) $(error mag_qmc5883l module error: please configure MAG_QMC5883L_I2C_DEV) endif
